title: Quality Engineer
description: The Quality Engineer is responsible for managing all quality assurance/control related activities for a specific deck of customers, including interaction with associates in other functional areas responsible for the same group of customers. Paramount in these activities is the short and long term resolution of internally and externally identified product non conformances. The Quality Engineer establishes and maintains effective communication with their end-use customers, including formal submission of root cause investigation and countermeasure activities. The Quality Engineer monitors adherence to the existing quality system, and along with the Quality team, works to develop and implement enhancements. Support of projects and activities that ensure continuously improving value to our customers is also expected.
requirements: Job Duties and Responsibilities:AnalysisPerform root cause analysis investigations.Develop and implement countermeasures.Conduct capability studies, certification reviews, internal audits and SPC studies.Understand ISO 9001 & 13485 requirements, and assist Quality Manager in facilitating third party audits. EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:Bachelor’s degree in engineering/engineering technology or materials science with a minimum of 3 years of progressively responsible quality control experience in a manufacturing environment.
